name: diagnose
context_rationale: The orchestrating skill must hold pass-template content in memory, manage the sequential Agent-spawn loop, invoke write_pass.py after each subagent returns, and run assemble.py — all requiring the parent conversation's tool access and cwd context.
summary: Produces a single self-contained interactive HTML diagnosis of a target codebase for the repo owner. Runs 11 analysis passes (10 general-purpose subagents plus one cross-reference pass) via code-review-graph-backed code graph analysis, then spawns the diagnose-narrator named subagent for the executive summary, and assembles everything via assemble.py. The deliverable is diagnose-out/diagnosis.html, which embeds findings as JSON for owner annotation. Never modifies source files in the target repo.

reads.purpose: Read by assemble.py to extract prior Confirmed/Notes annotations for carryover

outputs.purpose: Root output directory for all diagnose artifacts
AST-level code graph consumed by all analysis subagent passes
Per-pass prose sections written by write_pass.py
Per-pass structured findings YAML; 03b-duplicates.yaml and 03d-half-wired.yaml also read by 04-ai-bloat subagent
Per-pass one-paragraph summaries written by write_pass.py
Raw subagent response saved before write_pass.py invocation
Executive summary written by the diagnose-narrator named subagent
Final self-contained interactive deliverable produced by assemble.py; embeds findings JSON and owner annotation controls

agents.name: diagnose-narrator
agents.when: Step 6.5 — after all 11 forensic passes have written their YAMLs and summaries
agents.purpose: Writes the executive summary (sections/00-overview.md) from findings/*.yaml and summary/*.md using fresh context

tools.name: write_pass
tools.purpose: Orchestrator-side writer: parse each subagent's 4-backtick fenced section/findings/summary blocks, normalize + validate findings, write the three per-pass files. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (used by /bug-hunt too).

tools.name: assemble
tools.purpose: Compose diagnose-out/diagnosis.html from per-pass artifacts; runs the shared finding_dedup after load + carries over prior annotations. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (used by /bug-hunt too).

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.invocation: code-review-graph build|update | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — builds/refreshes the code graph; reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run code-review-graph build, code-review-graph queries, write_pass.py, assemble.py, directory checks

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Load pass templates and finding-schema for embedding in subagent prompts; read source files within TARGET

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Verify expected per-pass output files exist

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write raw subagent response to $OUT/.tmp/<pass-name>.raw before invoking write_pass.py

harness_tools.name: Agent
harness_tools.purpose: Spawn each of the 10+1 analysis-pass general-purpose subagents and the diagnose-narrator named subagent

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
